scope: Implemented local handler contract, /api/v2 only (D103); not a deployment or remote calculator approval
handler_dispatch: Every event is handed to the assembled application's course_http (CourseHttp.dispatch); no other route family remains

boot_failure_response.applies_to: a service without an assembled course_http, or an application that failed to boot

implemented_wait: No in-process wait; queued/processing calculation responses are an early 202 with calculationStatus pending

dependencies: DummyDevCourseProvider (course_v2_dummy, Dev stage only) with its mapping document
JourneyService typed commands (login_command, check_session, reauthorize_command, cancel_command)
JourneyStorage with explicit S3 client and legacy bindings
roles.runtime_status: mock_journey.runtime.get_application assembles build_course_application through aws_runtime.build_runtime('api'); the explicit course section is required and any configuration error fails closed as 503 TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE

events: SQS Records containing only a job_id reference
dependencies: JourneyStorage with explicit S3 client and legacy bindings
roles.runtime_status: mock_journey.worker_runtime.get_worker assembles build_worker through aws_runtime.build_runtime('worker'); the course section is validated offline only; any configuration or runtime error is raised as TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE so the batch is retried

events: DynamoDB Stream keys and sequence numbers
dependencies: DynamoJobRepository with explicit table binding and the existing fixed GSI1 due index
roles.runtime_status: mock_journey.worker_runtime.get_relay assembles build_relay through aws_runtime.build_runtime('relay') without a course section; any configuration or runtime error is raised as TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE so the invocation is retried

deployment_review_required: Per-team-member test access protection ahead of every /api/v2 route including login; the application does not implement this outer identity provider
Prevent direct unauthenticated invocation of legacy lambda_handler.run or alternate deployment routes
REST proxy header/body/base64 preservation and ingress payload/timeout enforcement
Actual deployment configuration, the Dev-only course_v2_dummy section and complete program definitions require separate verification
Role identities, resource identifiers, actual least-privilege IAM/resource policies and credentials are not supplied by this manifest
Platform SQS receive/delete, stream read permissions, trigger retry/DLQ settings and scheduled reconciliation need deployment configuration; these are not application SDK calls

Presigned URL generation is a signing operation, not an S3 SDK network request; verify the signing identity's object read permission and policies; the URL holder does not need separate AWS credentials
Storage retention/deletion, encryption and logging policies require infrastructure evidence; no retention duration or deletion job is created here

course_v2.note: The API role is always assembled by build_course_application. /mock/v1 and its /cpr-analysis alias were removed (D103); stored legacy attempts and jobs keep read, reauthorize, cancel and calculation finalize.
course_v2.query_parameters: allowlist per APP_ROUTES; empty query maps remain omitted
course_v2.measurement_content_type: After authentication and before any attempt read: a Content-Type duplicated by letter case, a multiValueHeaders value that is not exactly one item, or headers/multiValueHeaders disagreement is 400 INVALID_REQUEST without parsing; a present value from headers or multiValueHeaders must be a nonempty string without a comma, CR or LF, else 400 INVALID_REQUEST; a valid multiValueHeaders-only value is then copied once into headers for the parser
course_v2.legacy_attempt_recovery: new routes, no provider, nullable course fields
